WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: This artifact was MISSING from the run directory. The proof-validation work was performed and its results were consumed downstream (the severity-classifier's evidenceVerification block, the CLASS-002 medium->low reversal, and the M-01 write-up all depend on it), but it existed only in an agent transcript. A run whose conclusions cannot be reproduced from its own directory is not reproducible. Per project memory ('subagent tool output is not evidence'), results reported in a transcript and never persisted are exactly the failure mode that produced confabulated Medusa results on an earlier project. This file persists the real results. It is a RECORD of validation already performed, written after the fact; it is not itself a fresh validation run.

validationOutcomes.outcome: SCOPED -- the finding stands, but one of its two legs carries a precondition that the write-up must state
validationOutcomes.detail: M-01's RUNBOOK leg requires an IMPAIRED (R < P) prior migration. It is not reachable from a healthy migration. Proven by an at-par probe: with R == P the sweep leaves ZERO dust and initiateMigration SUCCEEDS rather than bricking. The impairment is what creates the unmatched idle residue that the sweep then strands.
validationOutcomes.unaffectedLeg: M-01's DONATION leg needs NO such precondition -- any party can push the pool's idle balance above the swept amount for the price of gas, on a perfectly healthy pool. The Medium is carried by this leg, which is why the precondition on the runbook leg does not reduce the finding's severity.
validationOutcomes.consequence: The M-01 write-up must not present the runbook leg as unconditional. It does not; recorded here so a future reader can check that.

validationOutcomes.target: L-06 (ss14l6, 7cdb92fdc71a660cae65b1cdeeaf334092ba889d9a56477f8c8c88bd1947e17f) -- filed as M-02 at classification time
validationOutcomes.outcome: PREMISE REFUTED -- drove the medium -> low downgrade
validationOutcomes.refutedPremise: 'No owner remedy exists for the self-aliased / mis-wired migrator; the only route back is every user calling userMigrate by hand, and one unresponsive staker makes the freeze permanent.'
validationOutcomes.detail: False. The MIGRATOR's endpoints are immutable, but the STAKER's `migrator` pointer is not: StableStaker.setMigrator (src/StableStaker.sol:200) is a plain `external onlyOwner` setter with no poolState gate, no pause gate and no exists gate. The owner deploys a correctly-wired replacement migrator and re-points the staker at it -- 3 owner transactions, ZERO user cooperation.
validationOutcomes.confirmation: Independently re-verified in source at 8856781 by the severity-auditor (ZZ_AuditorProbe.t.sol), which ruled the downgrade CORRECT with no third reversal proposed.
validationOutcomes.consequence: classified-findings.json CLASS-002 corrected to low / L-06 and flaggedForHumanReview cleared; published in submissions/qa-report.md as [L-06]. The finding is NOT withdrawn -- the missing destination-precondition checks remain a Law-3 footgun at Low.

validationOutcomes.outcome: SUB-CLAIM REFUTED -- the finding stands, one asserted aggravator does not
validationOutcomes.refutedClaim: 'No privileged actor can clear the planted dust.'
validationOutcomes.detail: False. Demonstrated via a strategy-less staging staker: StableStaker._routeDeposit (src/StableStaker.sol:769-770) returns `amount` IN FULL when no strategy is set ('idle hold: full credit'), so routing the migration through a staging staker with no yield strategy credits the destination at par and the dust-poison revert does not fire. A privileged actor therefore does have a clearing path.
validationOutcomes.consequence: L-01 remains a valid Low -- the wrong-side guard is real and the griefing vector is permissionless and cheap -- but the write-up must not claim the condition is unclearable by any privileged actor. Recorded so the claim is not resurrected in a later run.

validationOutcomes.refutedPremise: 'No owner escape whatsoever from the swept surplus; require(principalOf == 0, "incomplete exit") is unsatisfiable without a full user exit.'
validationOutcomes.detail: False. lib/reflax-yield-vault/src/AYieldStrategy.sol:654 relinquishPrincipalAsOwner(client, amount) onlyOwner -> _relinquishInternal, which at :679 executes clientBalances[token][balanceHolder] -= amount. principalOf at :523-525 returns exactly clientBalances[token][account] -- the SAME SLOT. The strategy owner therefore clears the swept surplus in ONE transaction with zero user cooperation. withdrawAsOwner (:644) is an independent second clear. _relinquishInternal touches no vault shares ('vault shares are deliberately untouched', :678), so the clear leaks nothing.

provenanceCaveat.issue: workspace/stable-staker's git HEAD still reads d95f4a6 (the run-13 baseline) with staged modifications, NOT 8856781. This looks like the PoCs were validated against the wrong commit. They were not.
provenanceCaveat.cause: The workspace sync to 8856781 was performed as a FILE COPY, not a git checkout, so the working tree contents advanced to 8856781 while the git metadata stayed at d95f4a6. git HEAD is therefore NOT the authority on what was compiled here and must not be cited as such.
provenanceCaveat.authority: `diff -rq` of workspace/stable-staker against lib/stable-staker at 8856781 is the authority on what was actually built and tested. It was CLEAN.
provenanceCaveat.reverified: finding-manager re-ran `diff -rq workspace/stable-staker/src lib/stable-staker/src` at 8856781 on 2026-08-27 while persisting this file: still clean, zero differences.
provenanceCaveat.recommendation: Sync the workspace with a real checkout in future runs so git HEAD and tree contents agree; the file-copy shortcut leaves every artifact in the run looking as though it was validated against a stale commit.
